THEBRUTE-STRIKE.title: Strike
THEBRUTE-DEFEND.title: Defend
THEBRUTE-BRISTLE.title: Bristle
THEBRUTE-KARMA_STRIKE.title: Karma Strike
THEBRUTE-KARMA_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you received unblocked attack damage last turn, hits twice.
THEBRUTE-FORCE.title: Force
THEBRUTE-BUTTERSNIPS.title: Buttersnips
THEBRUTE-BUTTERSNIPS.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Thorns[/gold] you have.
THEBRUTE-INNER_FIRE.title: Inner Fire
THEBRUTE-DISTORT.title: Distort
THEBRUTE-INCINERATE.title: Incinerate
THEBRUTE-POSSESSION.title: Possession
THEBRUTE-POSSESSION.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
[red]Vakuu plays your next turn for you.[/red]
THEBRUTE-RAZOR_FORM.title: Razor Form
THEBRUTE-RAZOR_FORM.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, gain {RazorFormPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-LIQUIDATE.title: Liquidate
THEBRUTE-FULMINATE.title: Fulminate
THEBRUTE-FULMINATE.description:
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold] X times.
Next turn, gain {TemporaryThornsUpNextTurnPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold] X times.
THEBRUTE-CRASH.title: Crash
THEBRUTE-POISE.title: Poise
THEBRUTE-ENGORGE.title: Engorge
THEBRUTE-ENGORGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
If not, gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
THEBRUTE-PROTOTYPE.title: Prototype
THEBRUTE-PROTOTYPE.description: Whenever you gain or inflict a buff or debuff, gain {PrototypePower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-UNFLINCHING.title: Unflinching
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.title: Exploit
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Choose a card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THEBRUTE-TORMENT.title: Torment
THEBRUTE-TORMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
THEBRUTE-RAG_ON.title: Rag On
THEBRUTE-WEAPONIZE.title: Weaponize
THEBRUTE-WEAPONIZE.description: Whenever you attack an enemy this turn, gain {WeaponizePower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BRACE.title: Brace
THEBRUTE-BRACE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BRACE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
THEBRUTE-WALL_OF_THORNS.title: Wall of Thorns
THEBRUTE-STOCKADE.title: Stockade
THEBRUTE-COLLAPSE.title: Collapse
THEBRUTE-SCHEME.title: Scheme
THEBRUTE-LEVERAGE.title: Leverage
THEBRUTE-HYSTERIA.title: Hysteria
THEBRUTE-HYSTERIA.description:
Every second turn, lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP and {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
 At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THEBRUTE-HEDGE.title: Hedge
THEBRUTE-HEDGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} additional {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
THEBRUTE-DEATH_WISH.title: Death Wish
THEBRUTE-DEATH_WISH.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, add {DeathWishPower:diff()} random {DeathWishPower:plural:Attack|Attacks} into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.description:
Add [gold]Replay[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It costs an extra {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to add [gold]Replay[/gold] and a [gold]Max HP Cost[/gold] to.
THEBRUTE-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.title: Hostile Takeover
THEBRUTE-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. ALL enemies lose 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-FRUSTRATION.title: Frustration
THEBRUTE-FRUSTRATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If you lost Max HP this turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BEATING.title: Beating
THEBRUTE-BEATING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each time you lost Max HP this combat.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
THEBRUTE-FRAGMENT.title: Fragment
THEBRUTE-NOURISH.title: Nourish
THEBRUTE-NOURISH.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your last played Attack or Skill.
THEBRUTE-OVERLOOK.title: Overlook
THEBRUTE-HIGH_ROLLER.title: High Roller
THEBRUTE-HIGH_ROLLER.description: Whenever you gain or lose [gold]Gold[/gold], gain {HighRollerPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CRUEL_STRIKE.title: Cruel Strike
THEBRUTE-REAR_HOOK.title: Rear Hook
THEBRUTE-VICTIMIZE.title: Victimize
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_COAGULANT.title: Blood Coagulant
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_COAGULANT.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] and {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-POISON_MIND.title: Poison Mind
THEBRUTE-FIRST_CLASS.title: First Class
THEBRUTE-FIRST_CLASS.description:
Deal damage equal to ALL gold gained and lost this combat.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
THEBRUTE-DESPERATION.title: Desperation
THEBRUTE-DESPERATION.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Put ALL 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ENCIRCLE.title: Encircle
THEBRUTE-ACCUMULATE.title: Accumulate
THEBRUTE-ACCIDENT.title: Accident
THEBRUTE-ACCIDENT.description: Whenever you gain or lose [gold]Gold[/gold], a random enemy takes {AccidentPower:diff()} damage.
THEBRUTE-RECKLESS_STRIKE.title: Reckless Strike
THEBRUTE-RECKLESS_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold] cost to a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
THEBRUTE-RUSH.title: Rush
THEBRUTE-MASSACRE.title: Massacre
THEBRUTE-MASSACRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, hits twice.
THEBRUTE-TOTALITY.title: Totality
THEBRUTE-TOTALITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you received unblocked attack damage last turn, hits four times.
THEBRUTE-EXPLOSION.title: Explosion
THEBRUTE-EXPLOSION.description:
At the start of your turn, deal damage equal to {ExtraAsPercent}% of your Max HP to ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
THEBRUTE-DIVERGE.title: Diverge
THEBRUTE-IMMUNIZE.title: Immunize
THEBRUTE-IMMUNIZE.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, other players gain {ImmunizePower:diff()} Max HP.
THEBRUTE-INFUSE.title: Infuse
THEBRUTE-INFUSE.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-DEGRADE.title: Degrade
THEBRUTE-DEGRADE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each Attack played this turn.
THEBRUTE-AMEND.title: Amend
THEBRUTE-AMEND.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Transform {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Ridicule+|Ridicule}[/gold].
THEBRUTE-REVEAL_WEAKNESS.title: Reveal Weakness
THEBRUTE-LASH_OUT.title: Lash Out
THEBRUTE-LASH_OUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CHARGE_AHEAD.title: Charge Ahead
THEBRUTE-CHARGE_AHEAD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, gain {TemporaryThornsUpNextTurnPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-HOLD_OUT.title: Hold Out
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.title: Envelop
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.description:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
THEBRUTE-ATTUNE.title: Attune
THEBRUTE-ATTUNE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Next turn, put a card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ATTUNE.selectionScreenPrompt: Select a card to put in your Hand.
THEBRUTE-GUARD.title: Guard
THEBRUTE-EMBARASS.title: Embarass
THEBRUTE-EMBARASS.description: Enemy deals 50% less damage but hits {EmbarassPower:diff()} more {EmbarassPower:plural:time|times}.
THEBRUTE-IMPULSE.title: Impulse
THEBRUTE-IMPULSE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] ALL your Skills.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
THEBRUTE-COMBO.title: Combo
THEBRUTE-COMBO.description: This turn, your next Attack is played {ComboPower:diff()} extra {ComboPower:plural:time|times}.
THEBRUTE-TWIST_THE_KNIFE.title: Twist the Knife
THEBRUTE-TWIST_THE_KNIFE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} spent this combat.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.)|}
THEBRUTE-SUPREMACY.title: Supremacy
THEBRUTE-SUPREMACY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} you play in a turn, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BITTER_EMBRACE.title: Bitter Embrace
THEBRUTE-BITTER_EMBRACE.description: At the start of your turn, add {BitterEmbracePower:diff()} random [gold]Gold[/gold] related card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-HEAVE.title: Heave
THEBRUTE-HEAVE.description:
Lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold] X times.
Exhaust {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-HUNKER_DOWN.title: Hunker Down
THEBRUTE-SAFEGUARD.title: Safeguard
THEBRUTE-SAFEGUARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
When [gold]Retained[/gold], increase its [gold]Block[/gold] by {RetainBlock:diff()} this combat.
THEBRUTE-RIPOSTE.title: Riposte
THEBRUTE-RIPOSTE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The next {FreeAttackPower:cond:>1?{FreeAttackPower:diff()} Attacks|Attack} you play {FreeAttackPower:plural:costs|cost} 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
THEBRUTE-SALVAGE.title: Salvage
THEBRUTE-SALVAGE.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Reduce your [gold]Maximum Hand Size[/gold] by {SalvagePower:diff()}.
THEBRUTE-STEAL.title: Steal
THEBRUTE-USURP.title: Usurp
THEBRUTE-EXTEND.title: Extend
THEBRUTE-EXTEND.description: At the start of the next {ExtendPower:diff()} {ExtendPower:plural:turn|turns}, gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-GLUTTONY.title: Gluttony
THEBRUTE-GASH.title: Gash
THEBRUTE-DISINTER.title: Disinter
THEBRUTE-DISINTER.description:
Lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Permanently increase this card's [gold]Gold[/gold] cost by {GoldCostIncrease:diff()} and Max HP gain by {MaxHpGainIncrease:diff()}.
THEBRUTE-DECEIVE.title: Deceive
THEBRUTE-DECEIVE.description: Add {DeceivePower:diff()} {DeceivePower:plural:copy|copies} of the third Skill you play each turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-GOUGE.title: Gouge
THEBRUTE-GOUGE.description: Remove all [gold]Block[/gold] from ALL enemies and deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEBRUTE-QUIP.title: Quip
THEBRUTE-QUIP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Increase this card's cost by 1.
THEBRUTE-RIDICULE.title: Ridicule
THEBRUTE-GNAW.title: Gnaw
THEBRUTE-GNAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Increase the damage of ALL Gnaw cards by {DamageIncrease:diff()} this combat.
THEBRUTE-OVERKILL.title: Overkill
THEBRUTE-OVERKILL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
If this kills an enemy, ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CRYBLOOD.title: Cryblood
THEBRUTE-CRYBLOOD.description:
At the start of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {ExtraAsPercent}% of your Max HP{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].)|}
THEBRUTE-RACEMIZATION.title: Racemization
THEBRUTE-RACEMIZATION.description:
Lose {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
